definitions.explanation: Valuable possessions such as gold, jewels, and precious objects. Often associated with stories of hidden or buried treasure, historical artifacts, or pirate lore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海賊|かいぞく}→海賊：13288_kaizoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{財宝|ざいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{財宝|ざいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Treasure was discovered in an old castle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{莫大|ばくだい}→莫大：03700_bakudai⟧な{財宝|ざいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{埋|う}められている→埋める：01901_umeru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: According to legend, an enormous treasure is buried somewhere on this island.

notes:
Composed of {財|ざい} (wealth) + {宝|ほう} (treasure). A somewhat literary word for valuable possessions such as gold, jewels, and precious objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {財宝|ざいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search for treasure
- {埋蔵|まいぞう}{財宝|ざいほう}: buried treasure
- {財宝|ざいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}する→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧: to discover treasure
- {財宝|ざいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect treasure
- ⟦{海賊|かいぞく}→海賊：13288_kaizoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{財宝|ざいほう}: pirate treasure

REGISTER:
Used in adventure stories, legends, historical contexts, and news about archaeological discoveries. Not commonly used in casual everyday speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宝物|たからもの}→宝物：12269_takaramono⟧: treasure, prized possession (everyday word, also used for personal valuables)
- ⟦{宝|たから}→宝：03401_takara⟧: treasure (general, broader use)
- ⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧: assets, property, fortune (more practical/legal)
- お⟦{宝|たから}→宝：03401_takara⟧: treasure, valuable find (casual, also used for rare collectibles)
